newsitem.title: CHINA: China launches large shipping group in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: China launches large shipping group in Shanghai.

text.p: China has launched a major shipping company, the China Shipping Group Co, in Shanghai, the Shanghai Securities News said on Monday.
The company combines China's three biggest regional shipping companies in Shanghai, Guangzhou and Dalian and two other minor shipping firms, the newspaper said.
The establishment of the group is aimed at making China's shipping business more efficient by creating big enterprises, it said.
The move to put the group's headquarters in Shanghai will also help the eastern city to become an international shipping and navigational centre, the newspaper said.

The new company has controlling stakes in Shanghai Haixing Shipping Co, a Chinese company which lists H shares in Hong Kong, and Hainan Haisheng Shipping Co, a Shanghai-listed domestic A share company, the newspaper said.
Shanghai Haixing was formerly owned by the Shanghai Shipping Co and Hainan Haisheng by the Guangzhou Shipping Co, it said.
